title: Oozing Brazilian Bresaola Pao de Queijo
description: Tangy, glassy-jelly, indulgent Brazilian dish featuring bresaola, brine-dry, and perfect for Buddhist-temple-friendly gathering.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together bresaola, pao de queijo cheese, butter, salt, black pepper, and garlic.
On a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, create a nest of fresh parsley.
In a small saucepan, combine red wine vinegar, honey, and water over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and brush the mixture over the parsley nest.
Place the bresaola mixture on top of the parsley nest, spreading evenly.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the bresaola is cooked through and the cheese is melted and slightly browned.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
